$comment: Pensara's deployment inventory: which providers serve which model reference, and what each of them calls the model.
It holds no Oxy-owned concept — no account, application, credential, price or commercial permission. See AGENTS.md.

snapshotId and issuedAt are REQUIRED. Staleness is measured from issuedAt, not from when Pensara last read this file, so the publisher must re-issue the snapshot on a cadence shorter than RELAY_INVENTORY_MAX_AGE even when nothing has changed. An unchanged file with an old issuedAt is indistinguishable, from Pensara, from a control plane that has stopped publishing.
Two deployments of one modelReference are a same-model failover set: the same weights, two places to get them. Pensara never substitutes a different model.

By default Pensara does NOT use the second one. Choosing among the deployments of a model is governed by routing-policy values the envelope does not carry (routingFallbackPolicy.sameModelDeployment, allowedRegions, deniedRegions), so without RELAY_ASSUME_FAILOVER_AUTHORIZED a reference resolves to the deployment declared FIRST here and nowhere else. See README, 'The policy Pensara is not sent'.
